aboutText: Platinum Air has been providing expert heating and cooling solutions to Ravenhall and Melbourne's western suburbs for years. Our experienced team specialises in reverse cycle ducted systems, gas ducted heating, hydronic heating, evaporative cooling and split systems. We deliver tailored residential and commercial solutions designed to keep your space comfortable all year round. Call us today for a free quote.
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive HVAC solutions for Ravenhall and beyond
servicesText: Platinum Air offers a full range of climate control services including ducted systems, split systems, hydronic heating and evaporative cooling for residential and commercial clients throughout Ravenhall and surrounding suburbs.

services.desc: Reverse cycle and gas ducted systems delivering whole-home heating and cooling across Ravenhall properties.

services.desc: Gentle, consistent warmth using water-based systems including in-slab floor coil heating solutions.
